QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] The Masteria Research Team
QuestInfo.0: The scientist you saved is Becky, the youngest member of the Masteria Research Team. She thanks you, and tells you of her plans to continue pursuing her field study. She'd probably stand a better chance of surviving if you were with her.
